title: Consultation agenda
idea: Consultation agenda: The visitor previews the concrete questions a consultation answers before selecting a supported time or contact path.
audience: People who need to plan consultation within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: The service begins with a bounded expert conversation.
avoidWhen: An appointment selector has no real availability source.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic decision layout through its plan consultation priority and explicit commitment contract: Confirm only authoritative availability; preserve a request-pending state.
navigation: Consultation agenda keeps the current plan consultation context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: The visitor previews the concrete questions a consultation answers before selecting a supported time or contact path.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to plan consultation; the service begins with a bounded expert conversation.
composition.priority: Confirm only authoritative availability; preserve a request-pending state.

imagery.role: Support the actual plan consultation context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Explain scope before time selection and preserve drafted questions if the keyboard opens.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the consultation agenda structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no plan consultation content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Confirm only authoritative availability; preserve a request-pending state.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized plan consultation content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Confirm only authoritative availability; preserve a request-pending state.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active plan consultation context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
